outcome_summary: Blocked by unresolved piranha-chest preparation, then repeated fallback waits
outcome_reason: Fallback stopped after 128 accepted waits without observed gameplay progress
improvements: Unknown-potion staging now preflights protection of other carried potions using the same stash-route checks as actual stashing.
Infeasible unstarted stash preparation declines locally rather than disabling unrelated floor potion work.
incoming_learnings: An admitted protected reward journey is insufficient for an unknown potion test: verify protection of other carried potions before choosing its staging bank. Local preparation infeasibility must not unnecessarily disable unrelated mandatory room work.

review.review: Blocked, not dead: the final accepted wait advanced the clock from 584 to 585 with full HP. The initiating preparation gap was already present at decision 104 (log line 281), before hunger: reconstructed admission found only bank 911 safe for unknown testing, but only entrance 943 supported the protected chest journey. Their intersection was empty. The exterior dry-bank trip exceeds the existing hypothetical protection budget including interaction and safety reserve. At decision 334 (lines 961-963), mandatory pool completion vetoed descent and fallback waiting began. Decision 459 ate after starvation (lines 1336-1337), but fallback resumed. Source browsing and offline reconstruction validated exact selected actions, reasons and controllers for all decisions 0-588; this is reconstructed bookkeeping, not recorded runtime memory. An isolated hunger-free copy still declined preparation. The played stash preflight is downstream of the empty bank/journey intersection, so it is not established as the initiating cause. No patch is supplied: admitting the doorway for unknown testing, spending possible invisibility away from an admitted trip, or reducing protection reserve lacks a demonstrated safe basis. The observations supply no usable identification resource or verified alternative preparation plan. Mandatory collection and existing hazard gates remain unchanged.
review.learnings: Check joint test-bank and protected-trip feasibility before attributing a pool stall to hunger or stash preflight. An observed mandatory chest and carried unknown potions do not establish a safe retrieval strategy. Preserve public identification, actual protection checks, interaction reserve and verified collection receipts.

recommendations.summary: Establish a safe preparation strategy for pool entrances with no jointly admitted unknown-test bank and protected reward trip.

recommendations.reason: Full selector browsing and validated reconstruction resolve the missing arbitration and memory evidence, but do not establish a safe replacement. The sole admitted journey start is excluded by unknown-test safety, while the dry test bank exceeds the protected round-trip budget. A justified preparation or public-identification mechanism preserving those gates is needed; the recorded inventory provides no usable identification resource. Relaxing door safety or protection reserve, guessing potion identity, or adding an early meal would not be an evidence-backed focused repair.
